conventions.gd: Step0 is analytic zero initialization; all remaining errors are actual executed checkpoints.

conventions.crossings: Except exact1% hits, intervals bracket first threshold crossings between observed checkpoints of monotone frozen GD.
conventions.joint: All39 raw snapshots per seed; straight plotting segments are not intervening observations.
conventions.normalization: Targets normalized using original2048-grid RMS; relative L2 denominator evaluated on each grid.
